description: This file defines the configuration class for the Attendance plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It implements plugin configuration interface and registers the AttendanceService with the dependency injection container during initialization.

classes.name: AttendancePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the Attendance plugin, specifically registering the AttendanceService during plugin initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering the AttendanceService with the container.
